newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund flows drop in 2-day period.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund flows drop in 2-day period.

text.p: Cash flows into U.S. stock funds slowed to to an industrywide $1.40 billion for the two days ended May 27 compared with $4.84 for the three days ended May 22, according to an estimate by Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm said that aggressive growth funds dropped to $229 million from $1.34 billion, growth funds fell to $357 million from $1.66 billion and growth and income funds halved to $892 million from $1.65 billion.
International funds were off to $1.09 billion from $1.53 billion.

Bond funds slowed their redemptions to $330 million from $585 million. Government/GNMA funds had outflows of $103 million versus outflows of $124 million, and muni funds had outflows of $196 million versus outflows of $403 million. High yield edged up to inflows of $9 million from outflows of $129 million.
